old_problem: The active record left this review pending for the exact topology, tool version and definitions.yml thresholds. The upstream TransferBench specification now establishes the p2p workload semantics and matrix output, while the missing per-cell AGFHC limits can be treated as mandatory project configuration under ED-03/ED-15 rather than an unresolved command meaning.
disposition_reason: ROCm TransferBench documents that the p2p preset measures CPU-to-CPU, CPU-to-GPU and GPU-to-GPU pairs, can select bidirectional mode and GPU DMA, and outputs a labeled bandwidth matrix. Thus the core workload is authoritative. ED-03 permits the applicable topology and pinned definition artifact as runtime configuration, ED-14 preserves the entire size sweep rather than a sample, and ED-15 forbids PASS until every matrix cell is evaluated against the signed definitions.yml rule. Missing thresholds remain execution prerequisites and do not keep the review pending.

test_case.test_name: Complete 1K-to-1G ROCm TransferBench bidirectional CPU/GPU pair bandwidth matrix
test_case.purpose: Measure saturated bidirectional copy bandwidth for every applicable CPU/GPU source-destination pair at every power-of-two size from 1 KiB through 1 GiB and evaluate each cell against the approved MI300 AGFHC definition.
required_package: Pinned checksum-verified ROCm TransferBench build plus compatible ROCm/AMDGPU stack
Pinned AGFHC package and exact `/opt/amd/agfhc/hclib/mi300/definitions.yml` content/hash
Approved GPU serial/UUID/BDF and CPU NUMA-node topology with the complete applicable pair matrix
Approved IOMMU, large-BAR, memory-type, P2P_MODE=2 bidirectional, USE_GPU_DMA=1, iteration/subexecutor and output settings for the pinned build
Dedicated maintenance window, per-GPU/link/RAS/thermal/power abort thresholds, independent access and cleanup/recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After validating artifact hashes, topology, IOMMU/large-BAR/P2P prerequisites and an isolated window, record the exact TransferBench environment and run the approved p2p bidirectional GPU-DMA profile for each size `1K 2K 4K 8K 16K 32K 64K 128K 256K 512K 1M 2M 4M 8M 16M 32M 64M 128M 256M 512M 1G`. Preserve untruncated stdout/stderr and labeled pair matrices for every size, while synchronously recording GPU/link/RAS/thermal/power telemetry. Join every expected pair/size cell to the exact signed definitions.yml threshold and retain skipped/unsupported pair reasons.
test_case.expected_result: All expected CPU/GPU and GPU/GPU pairs produce complete attributable bidirectional results at all 21 sizes, every applicable matrix cell meets its versioned AGFHC minimum/maximum rule and unit, no required pair is silently skipped, and no disallowed DMA, IOMMU, P2P, XGMI/PCIe, RAS, thermal, power or system error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the immutable topology and artifact hashes, complete expected-pair × 21-size matrix, untruncated raw output, exact definitions.yml rule and threshold evaluation for every applicable cell, explicit allowed skips and clean synchronized health evidence. Without the signed definition artifact or any required cell, the result is NOT EVALUATED; driver/IOMMU lines or a tail sample cannot pass.
safety_gate: Run only in a dedicated high-load window with independent management and confirmed cooling/power headroom
Verify stable GPU/CPU topology, compatible TransferBench build, IOMMU/large-BAR/P2P and memory-mode prerequisites before load
Do not invent per-cell thresholds, truncate output or silently exclude slow/missing pairs
Preserve complete pre/during/post link, RAS, dmesg, thermal and power telemetry without clearing history
Abort on GPU loss/reset, XGMI/PCIe error, IOMMU fault, RAS event, thermal/power limit, hang or access loss; clean up once and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: TransferBench/ROCm/driver and AGFHC definitions.yml versions, checksums and exact environment/profile
GPU UUID/BDF and CPU NUMA topology plus expected applicable pair matrix
Untruncated command/stdout/stderr and labeled bandwidth matrix for every 1K-to-1G size
Per-cell observed value, unit, definition key/threshold and evaluation table including explicit skips
Synchronized XGMI/PCIe, IOMMU, GPU/RAS, thermal/power and system-log evidence
test_case.recovery: On a fault or missing result, stop the active TransferBench process, preserve the complete partial matrix and telemetry, verify every GPU/CPU/P2P path and management health through read-only sources, remove only temporary workload artifacts and escalate. Do not rerun a failed cell or the whole sweep automatically.
